How to read these prices

Every item has two sides. The asking price is what sellers on the auction house want for one item, based on the cheapest listings so a single odd listing cannot skew it. The top buy order is what a buyer has already offered to pay, so it is the price you get if you sell right now.

The gap between the two is the spread. A small spread means buyers and sellers agree on what an item is worth; a large one can mean an opportunity to flip, or simply an item that rarely trades. Items with only a handful of listings deserve a second look before you trust their price, and enchanted gear is priced separately for each combination of enchantments.
